description:
Stop every message you start to this customer from this number, until
the block is lifted. The response is `201` when the block is new and
`200` when the customer was already blocked, in which case the entry is
returned unchanged.

(Tags: WhatsApp)

number_id.description:
Id of a WhatsApp number in your workspace, from
[listWhatsappNumbers](/docs/api-reference/whatsapp/listWhatsappNumbers).
A number in another workspace answers `404`.

customer.description: The customer's number in international format, such as `+15551234567`.

name: addWhatsappOptOut
